title: The Legacy
logline: The '93 Subaru arrives, already dying. Gully looks under the hood and says 'hm.'

panels.composition: Gully's lot. A 1993 Subaru Legacy wagon, green, one hubcap, a blue tarp in the back. WOOD beside it like it's a horse he's not sure of. GULLY approaching wiping his hands. BARNABY, thirteen, in the passenger seat already.

balloons.text: The Datsun died. This is the Legacy.

image.prompt: a faded green 1993 Subaru Legacy wagon with one hubcap and a blue tarp in the back parked outside a shingle bait shop, a thin man standing beside it uncertainly, a stocky man approaching wiping his hands, an old dog already in the passenger seat, razor-sharp ink

panels.composition: Gully under the hood. A long look.

image.prompt: a stocky man looking under the raised hood of an old Subaru with a long thoughtful expression

balloons.text: All of it. Eventually. Bring it Tuesdays.

image.prompt: close-up of a thin man asking anxious questions beside a car

panels.composition: Wood driving off, a faint blue haze from the tailpipe, the dog's head out the window for the first time in years. Gully watching. The strip's car for the next decade.

image.prompt: an old green Subaru wagon pulling out of a gravel lot trailing a faint blue haze, an old dog's head out the window, a stocky man watching with his arms folded, no words

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: The Subaru. 'Hm.' Bring it Tuesdays. Ten years of Tuesdays.
